newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTO STAY ON TOP OF LEAGUE, BEAT MARITIMO 4-1.
newsitem.headline: PORTO STAY ON TOP OF LEAGUE, BEAT MARITIMO 4-1.

text.p: Defender Jose Barroso and Slovakian midfielder Zlatko Zahovic each scored twice to help reigning champions Porto crush Maritimo 4-1 at home on Monday and stay ahead of Benfica in the Portuguese first division.
Porto, who secured first place in Group D of the European Cup with a 1-1 draw against AC Milan last Wednesday, have 29 points, against Benfica's 26. Benfica beat Farense 2-1 at home on Sunday.

Porto's goalkeeper Henrique Hilario let in his first goal in 373 minutes when Maritimo opened the score in the 13th minute of the match with a shot inside the box by Brazilian striker Edmilson Lucena.
Porto were without captain Jorge Costa who underwent nose surgery last week after a scuffle with AC Milan's Liberian striker George Weah.
They levelled the score in the 38th minute with a 25-metre free kick by Barroso.
The champions took the lead in the 51st minute with a goal by Zahovic after a good pass by Brazilian winger Edmilson Pimenta.
Seven minutes from the final whistle, another free kick by Barroso gave Porto their third goal.
In injury time, Zahovic completed the rout with the fourth goal.
